description.value: Pacheedaht First Nation's campground sits between two rivers along a wild, driftwood-strewn mile of west coast shore near Port Renfrew, offering beachfront, riverside, and forested sites with easy road access. Open year-round, but unserviced tent sites run $45–57/night—budget accordingly.

address.value: 305 Pachidah Rd, Port Renfrew, BC V0S 1K0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence comes from the visitpacheedaht.ca website, which confirms year-round operation, an online booking system up to 90 days in advance, and multiple site types including serviced (power/water) and partial-serviced (water only) options. A notable address discrepancy exists: OSM lists '395 Pachidah Road' while the website footer consistently shows '305 Pachidah Rd, Port Renfrew, BC V0S 1K0' across all subpages, and the website header also lists a third address ('350 Kalaid Street') which likely belongs to the Nation's administrative office rather than the campground. OSM carries no phone number, but the website prominently lists (250) 647-0090; the website value is used for both address and phone.
